name: world-cup-assistant
description: 2026 FIFA World Cup Assistant — One-click launcher

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "cd server && npm start" "cd client && npm run dev"
